detail: binding secret.registry.deploy-token.v1 resolves to a credential with repo:write and packages:delete; node run_script declares capability.registry.read-only.v1, which allows repo:read only
recovery_requirement: bind a credential whose privilege is within capability.registry.read-only.v1, or have a human ratify a procedure version whose node declares the wider profile; then re-propose against the current ledger position
